concept.title: The Photos buttons
concept.shortdesc: What the buttons in the Photos part of a person's page are for.

conbody.p: A person's page has a part named . In a tree with no pictures, it has three buttons in a row. Each has a small picture on it and no words. The picture shows them at the foot of a page, under .

ul.li: The first button has a camera on it. It is the button for taking a photo.
The second button has a folder on it. It is the button for adding a file, such as a photo or a scan from your PC. Windows opens its own window for choosing a file. shows the steps.
The third button has a chain link on it. It is the button for linking media that is already in this tree.

section.title: The window for linking media
section.p: The third button opens a window named . It has a box named and a button named . When the tree has no pictures, the window says No media in this workspace yet. Choose to shut it.

section.title: When a person has pictures
section.p: Once a person has pictures, a fourth button shows, for saving them.

section.title: Sending your pictures
section.p: says which file to send to family, and whether the pictures go with it.
